The food is always consistently fresh and of an exceptionally high standard
Aug 2026 • Friends
Quán Bụi is one of my favourite restaurants in Ho Chi Minh City, and after my most recent four-day stay, it has once again reinforced why I keep coming back.

I’ve now dined here on three separate trips to Ho Chi Minh City, enjoying six meals in total, and the experience has been consistently outstanding every single time. The food is always fresh, beautifully prepared and remarkably consistent.

One of the things I love most about Quán Bụi is its extensive menu. It’s one of the most comprehensive Vietnamese menus I’ve seen anywhere in the country, and they also offer an excellent wine list to complement the food.

The restaurant was so good that we dined there on both Friday and Saturday evenings, making a point of trying different dishes each night. The Vietnamese pancake is exceptional, as are the grilled prawns on a stick. We also shared one of their rice paper roll platters, allowing us to make our own fresh rolls at the table—a fantastic experience and absolutely delicious.

Their classic Vietnamese dishes are equally impressive. The morning glory with chilli and garlic is superb, and the fried rice is excellent, whether you choose beef, chicken, seafood or egg. Whatever you order, it’s prepared with care and full of flavour.

The beer is always served beautifully cold, the prices are very reasonable, and the quality of the food is exceptional.

If you’re visiting, I’d recommend requesting a table upstairs, where I find it a little cooler and more comfortable than downstairs.

What keeps bringing me back, however, is more than just the food. It’s the genuine hospitality, the attentive service and the consistently high standard of every meal.

Well done to the entire team at Quán Bụi. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves over the weekend, and I’ll certainly be back on my next visit to Ho Chi Minh City.
